facts.fact: Bran 上门逼她搬走，还说难怪上一个住户直接人间蒸发。
facts.anchor: “You need to move out,” he snipes into my face. “Not enough Xanax in the world can handle you. No wonder the last guy up and disappeared.”

facts.fact: Bran 提出用约会换替她扛坏运气。
facts.anchor: “Though, I suppose I can handle your shit luck in exchange for a date.”

facts.fact: Bran 历数只有他们两家遭灾：停电、下水道倒灌、雷劈、水淹。
facts.anchor: It was only our apartments that lost power last night, just like it always is. It was only ours that had the sewage back-up. Only ours that were struck by lightning, frying all my electronics. Only ours that flooded.

facts.fact: Bran 从 Clementine 太太处听说：这份坏运气是从她搬来开始的。
facts.anchor: And from what I gathered from Miss Clementine, this bad luck started with you.

facts.fact: 她当面质问 Bran 昨晚跟车的事。
facts.anchor: “Whose car did you borrow to follow me home again last night and make me almost wreck?”

facts.fact: Bran 否认跟车，眼神躲闪到她的脚上。
facts.anchor: “That wasn’t me.” He exhales through his nose, his eyes jumping towards my feet.

facts.fact: 她打开邮箱发现只剩一封邮件。
她把邮件丢失归因于昨晚停电。
facts.anchor: I bet the power going out messed up my emails.

facts.fact: 唯一那封邮件全文：一位「人头」、尽快、供应全部所需——署名 B.L.T.。
facts.anchor: One head. ASAP. Will provide all supplies.

facts.fact: B.L.T. 回信说吃惊她要先见面——通常客户只报细节；所需物品由他们提供。
facts.anchor: I am surprised you wish to meet first…usually they just request details. Any items needed will be provided.

facts.fact: B.L.T. 强调绝对保密是必需的。
facts.anchor: And as I am sure you are aware the utmost discretion is necessary.

facts.fact: 她相信自己的运气终于要转好了。
facts.anchor: My luck is finally turning around.
